title: Lost Mary Maryliq Triple Berry Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Discover Maryliq: Lost Mary's iconic flavours as found in bestselling disposable vapes like the BM600, QM600 and AM600, are now available in 10ml nicotine salt e-liquids. Maryliq provides a discreet, yet richly flavoured vapour and a smooth throat hit, offering quick relief for your nicotine cravings. Available in 10mg & 20mg strengths, it's the ideal choice for recent quitters or those after immediate nicotine satisfaction. Unlike traditional high-PG freebase liquids, Maryliq's nic salts deliver a smoother throat hit and quicker nicotine absorption. Compatible with starter and pod vape kits, these 10ml bottles let you enjoy your favourite flavours longer than 2ml disposables, minimising plastic waste. Experience all-day vaping satisfaction and flavour with Maryliq Nic Salts. Take a flavour-packed journey through a frozen berry wonderland with Lost Mary Maryliq's Triple Berry Ice. This e-liquid is an amalgamation of juicy Blueberries, tart Raspberries, and succulent Strawberries, all wrapped up with a soothing Ice finish. It's a berry lover's dream come true, delivering a multi-layered vaping experience that's both nuanced and invigorating. The ice adds a refreshing twist, making it an excellent choice for an all-day vape or a revitalising pick-me-up. With its 50% VG / 50% PG blend, you can expect a smooth throat hit, balanced vapour production, and an authentic berry flavour that's complemented perfectly by the icy exhale.
